skill: Differentiate C a^{u(x)} by decomposing the composite, multiplying C a^u ln(a) by u prime, and (at hard difficulty) construct the tangent line at a supplied x coordinate.
reasoning_steps: Identify u and the outer general-base exponential.
Differentiate outer and inner functions; multiply by the chain rule and substitute u.
For slope tasks evaluate the derivative at the given point.
For hard tangent tasks evaluate both derivative and function, use y-y1=m(x-x1), then expand or simplify to a bank option.
invariants: General base a>0 and a!=1, elementary polynomial exponents, no extra product or quotient rule.
Hard source q-107463 has a five-choice radio tangent equation bank, not merely a derivative or slope.
All displayed transitions and the actual response field must refer to the same mathematical object.
No images, tables or augmented matrices occur in captured material.
permitted_variations: Vary positive general bases, constant multipliers, polynomial coefficients and translations within source-supported method.
Vary evaluation point, derivative sign, tangent slope and intercept, and correct choice position; source x=-1, base 4, positive slope and ln2 are incidental assignments.

Hard evidence directly supports linear-exponent tangent equations. Nonlinear exponents are supported for derivatives and slope evaluation, but extending hard tangent problems needs comparable workload justification.
